model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts comparing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, with data presented as percentages of the total economy and absolute values by NACE Rev. 2. The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows four sectors: Industry (8%, 2.4 mln), Construction (12%, 3.7 mln), Trade (19%, 5.9 mln), and Other Services (61%, 19.0 mln). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," shows: Industry (21%, 33.0 mln), Construction (9%, 13.4 mln), Trade (19%, 29.5 mln), and Other Services (51%, 80.2 mln). The third chart, "TURNOVER," shows: Industry (31%, 10.6 tn), Construction (6%, 1.9 tn), Trade (31%, 9.9 tn), and Other Services (31%, 9.8 tn). Each chart includes a legend at the bottom indicating the color coding for the four sectors, and the percentage and absolute value are labeled within each sector of the donut charts. The sectors are arranged in the charts in descending order of their percentage values.
